title: QA basics check
sourceNote: Original practice questions written for this check. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: One section, 30 questions, 40 minutes. Every question is type-in (TITA): there are no options and no negative marks.
No calculator for this check, so the calculator button is hidden. You can use rough paper.
Type the number only, with no %, ₹ or units. Use a decimal, not a fraction (1.5, not 3/2). Type a decrease as a negative number.
If you can't see how to start within about 30 seconds, leave it blank and move on.
If you answer but aren't sure, use Mark for Review & Next. The answer still counts, and the flag shows you which ones to recheck.
The site records how long you spend on each question, so you don't need to note slow ones.
Go in order. When the timer ends, the section submits itself.

questions.text: Write 3/8 as a percentage.
Write 1/7 as a percentage, to two decimal places.
A price rises by 20% and then falls by 20%. What is the net percentage change? Type a decrease as a negative number.
A's salary is 25% more than B's. By what percentage is B's salary less than A's?
₹1,200 is divided between P and Q in the ratio 3 : 5. What is Q's share, in rupees?
If a : b = 2 : 3, b : c = 4 : 5 and a + b + c = 70, find c.
The average of 5 numbers is 20. One number is removed, and the average of the remaining 4 numbers is 18. What number was removed?
2 kg of rice costing ₹40 per kg is mixed with 3 kg costing ₹50 per kg. What is the price per kg of the mixture, in rupees?
How many kg of tea costing ₹60 per kg must be mixed with 5 kg of tea costing ₹90 per kg to get a mixture worth ₹70 per kg?
A shopkeeper buys an item for ₹400, marks it 25% above cost, and then gives a 10% discount on the marked price. What is the profit percentage?
What is the compound interest, in rupees, on ₹10,000 at 10% per annum for 2 years, compounded annually?
A sum of money doubles itself in 8 years at simple interest. What is the rate of interest per annum, in percent?
A car travels from A to B at 30 km/h and returns from B to A at 60 km/h. What is its average speed for the whole journey, in km/h?
Two trains, 120 m and 180 m long, run on parallel tracks in opposite directions at 50 km/h and 40 km/h. How many seconds do they take to cross each other completely?
A can finish a job in 10 days and B can finish it in 15 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
A boat travels 24 km downstream in 2 hours and returns the same 24 km upstream in 3 hours. What is the speed of the stream, in km/h?
If 2x + 3y = 12 and 3x + 2y = 13, find x + y.
The roots of 2x² − 7x + 3 = 0 are p and q, with p > q. Find p − q.
If x + 1/x = 4, find x² + 1/x².
How many integers x satisfy |x − 3| < 5?
If 4ˣ = 8, find x. Type it as a decimal.
A father is now 3 times as old as his son. In 10 years he will be twice as old as his son. What is the son's present age, in years?
A chord of length 8 cm is drawn in a circle of radius 5 cm. How far is the chord from the centre, in cm?
What is the area, in cm², of an equilateral triangle with side 6 cm? Take √3 = 1.732 and give the answer to two decimal places.
What is each interior angle of a regular hexagon, in degrees?
How many positive divisors does 72 have?
What is the remainder when 2¹⁰ is divided by 7?
What is the smallest three-digit number that leaves a remainder of 1 when divided by each of 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6?
Find the sum of the first 10 terms of 3, 7, 11, 15, ...
In how many ways can a committee of 2 people be chosen from 5 people?
